facts.fact: 她（刚说完话的女子）头也不回地走掉，摔门重到把两张符震落在地；此后只剩 Archie 一人
facts.anchor: She left without a backwards glance, slamming the door so hard that a couple of the fu fluttered onto the floor.

facts.fact: Archie 独自低头看那几句把他困住的话——困住他的是「文字」，不是人或锁
facts.anchor: Alone, Archie looked down at the words that kept him prisoner.

facts.fact: 镇语原文即「Stop above wall, monster with man to one side.」；字面不通，本章未解释（似符上镇语或字谜），存疑不猜
facts.anchor: Stop above wall, monster with man to one side.

facts.fact: 「Wait for me」是她说的（她走前的吩咐），不是 Archie 说的；被要求等待的是 Archie
facts.anchor: Wait for me, she had said.

facts.fact: 但 Archie 体内的兽不肯等，立刻违背她的吩咐
facts.anchor: But the beast would not wait.

facts.fact: 兽在 Archie 自己体内（his skin＝Archie 的皮肤下），抓挠着要出来；不在她或旁人身上
facts.anchor: Beneath his skin, Archie felt it clawing to be let out.

facts.fact: 六个辱称像水车在脑中翻滚、越转越快：Son of a witch／Insipid commoner／Blasphemer／Gweilo／Yiugwai／Monster
facts.anchor: The litany of labels rolled through his head like a waterwheel, turning faster as it gained momentum.

facts.fact: 平日的礼貌冷淡只是薄薄一层漆，压不住这股怒气；怒意烧灼皮肤、沿背而下
facts.anchor: The veneer of polite indifference could not contain the rage.

facts.fact: 他吼叫着用肩膀撞那道「看不见的」屏障——屏障无实体可见，撞是靠肩
facts.anchor: He roared, slamming his shoulder against the unseen barricade.

facts.fact: 最易漏的转折：疼痛成了「美味的焦点」，痛反而证明他仍是人（still human），故他享受这痛
facts.anchor: The pain was a delicious focal point, a reminder that he was still human after all.

facts.fact: 撞后盐与米四外散开，屏障随散开而松动（松动≠破除）；屏障由符＋盐＋米构成
facts.anchor: Salt and rice scattered outwards, the barrier loosening as it spread.

facts.fact: 章末只有「Again.」：他还要再撞一次，屏障未破，本章即在此收束
